exposure: laparoscopic repair of the large niche
outcome: extent of scar healing (increase in scar thickness or residual myometrium (RM) and decrease in niche depth)
decrease in menstrual symptoms (duration of postmenstrual spotting, length of menstrual bleeding, menstrual pain, menstrual flow)
cohort: 127 patients with a cesarean section scar niche diagnosed by transvaginal ultrasound, meeting criteria for repair surgery (residual myometrium <2.5 mm) and desiring conception, who underwent laparoscopic repair.
finding: Laparoscopic repair of a cesarean section scar niche significantly improved scar parameters, alleviated menstrual symptoms, and led to a high rate of successful reproductive plans in patients desiring conception.
